description: Find road freight carriers in Europe that run a route and offer the equipment, services or certificates a load needs. Write the query plainly: the places of loading and delivery (town, postcode or country), then what is needed, e.g. "reefer from Venlo to Rome", "ADR tank Rotterdam to Poland", "groupage Germany to Italy, tail lift". "based in Italy" keeps carriers based there. Returns the carriers that fit, best first, with what the search understood: if that is not what the user meant, phrase the query again. It returns at most limit carriers (10 unless set, up to 25); carriers_that_fit counts all that fit, and results_url shows them all on fitralo.com. When nothing fits exactly, carriers_that_fit is 0 and the list has the carriers that come closest. A query without a route or need returns an error that says how to write it. Then call get_carrier for contact details. Read-only and without an account: it changes and books nothing. At most 300 calls an hour from one address, for all tools together.

language.description: The user's language as a two-letter code, when Fitralo has it: labels such as services and equipment, the profile description where it is translated, and the links to the site follow it.

query.description: The route and needs in plain words, in English or the language given.

specialists_only.description: Only carriers for whom this route (or area) is their own line, not one among many.
